Remark
[Non-collapsing constant for epsilon-round components depends on fundamental group order] ↗ def:kappa-noncollapsed-surgery ↗ def:epsilon-round-component

For sufficiently small $\epsilon $, an $\epsilon $-round component satisfies the preceding condition with a constant depending on the order of its finite fundamental group. If every finite free factor of the initial fundamental group has order at most $N$, one may choose $\kappa $ depending only on $N$.
